text: dsh-assembly.resume 是面向 DSH Web 的会话迁移插件，可将本机 Codex、Claude Code CLI 和 Claude Code Desktop 的原生对话导入 DSH Agent。它在 DSH 服务端发现并读取会话记录，将可见消息和工具活动整理为 DSH 对话种子，并通过设置页供用户选择来源和会话。主要功能包括按项目分组检索会话、预览消息、选择或替换工作区，以及接管后继续对话。适合希望把已有编码助手对话带入 DSH 的用户；需要本机已有对应会话文件，无需额外 API 密钥。

dsh-assembly.resume imports local Codex or Claude Code conversations into DSH Web. Browse sessions by project, preview messages, and hand one to a DSH Agent to continue. Choose a replacement workspace if needed. Local session files are required; no extra API key is needed.

dsh-assembly.resume 的功能「发现本机会话」：在设置页选择 Codex、Claude Code CLI 或 Desktop 并搜索会话。服务端读取本机记录，按最近更新时间列出匹配项目。
dsh-assembly.resume 的功能「导入并接管对话」：选中历史会话后点击接管，插件把对话事件整理成 DSH Agent 的初始消息，并创建对应会话记录。
dsh-assembly.resume 的功能「关联工作区」：接管时优先使用仍存在的原项目目录；用户也可选择替代目录。路径不可用时会话仍可不绑定工作区地打开。

dsh-assembly.resume README · dsh-assembly.resume：Bring an existing Codex or Claude Code conversation into DSH, then continue it
with the DSH Agent.
dsh-assembly.resume README · DSH Compatibility：- Supported DSH version: [`0.1.7-rc.2`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.1.7-rc.2) (Sep.24)

dsh-assembly.resume README · What It Does：- Finds local conversations from Codex, Claude Code CLI, and Claude Code Desktop.
- Groups conversations by their original project so they are easier to find.
- Imports the selected conversation into DSH, including its visible messages and tool activity.
- Automatically registers and binds an existing source directory as a DSH Workspace.
- If the historical path no longer exists or the original conversation had no workspace, a new workspace can be specified during handoff. Otherwise, the conversation imports unbound and the old directory is never recreated.
- Continue the conversation in DSH after transfer.

dsh-assembly.resume README · Installation：Install the package from npm:

```bash
npm install dsh-assembly.resume
```

Add it to a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-assembly.resume
```

Start DSH:

```bash
dsh web
```

Open Settings > Plugins and select **Session Resume** to choose a provider and
conversation.
